title.narrative: A.E.6. Number of students enrolled in revised/newly developed study programmes

comment.narrative: 12-05-2021: The start of the new Diploma Programme has been postponed till September 2021.

Too few students will be registering for the post-secondary higher TVET programme. The number of registered students for the first cohort (2019-2022) is not yet known at the time of writing, but in similar programs in fields like Biotechnology Food production the typical number of students registered per year is 20-30. Therefore the risk is evaluated as being small. To further mitigate this risk a modest marketing campaign will be launched, using a website, brochures and special exposure days at Fuheis for girls.
